run_glue_cola_preprocessing: run the Glue_Cola main function to generate 16-shot training data for multiple random seeds
create_glue_cola_dataset: create a Glue_Cola dataset instance to load the GLUE CoLA acceptability classification dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace GLUE CoLA dataset split to a list of sentence and label tuples
load_glue_cola_dataset: load the GLUE CoLA dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot learning splits for the GLUE CoLA dataset with a given seed
